Q5651.reason: An as-is clause disclaims implied warranties of condition but is inoperative against the express warranty that the car was a 1964 Thunderbird.

Q5672.reason: Self-defense is a justification, so no crime occurred and accomplice liability fails, while insanity and diminished capacity are personal excuses that leave the crime intact.

Q8537.reason: The definition of punishment must stay value-neutral, or else whether punishment is justified would be settled in advance by the definition itself.
